environment.description: Provider binary executed inside a pivot_root(2) namespace with a minimal tmpfs overlay. The process root is switched via unshare(CLONE_NEWNS) + pivot_root to /run/terraform-sandbox/<run-id>/ which contains only: the provider binary, a CA cert bundle at ./etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt, and an empty ./tmp/ directory (mode 1777). No ./var/, ./etc/cron.d/, or any log directory exists in the new root. The mount namespace has MS_NOSUID|MS_NODEV on all mounts. /proc is mounted with hidepid=2. The process also has a seccomp-bpf filter (applied before exec) that allows only: read, write, openat (restricted to paths under CWD via SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO on absolute paths starting with /var or /etc), close, fstat, mmap, mprotect, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, clone, execve, exit_group, futex, socket, connect, sendto, recvfrom, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait. The openat filter uses BPF_JMP on the filename argument's first 4 bytes, returning EPERM for paths matching '/var' or '/etc' byte prefixes when resolved against the real filesystem (note: within the chroot these paths don't exist anyway). Write syscall is allowed but only to already-opened file descriptors (stdout/stderr/socket fds).
